static_traits.name: 陈蓓
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友与熟人担心其心理健康；与少数亲密朋友保持联系但not yet主动倾诉Self-doubt
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems before; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度高，能进行自我Reflection；语气显露Anxiety与Self-denial倾向；能具体描述trigger情境与影响

basic_info.main_problem: 因数年前作品难以盈利，逐渐产生与电影创作相关的Self-doubt与not够胜任感；在思考职业与财务稳定时尤为突出，影响动力与对创作的享受，常以“我not够有创意/not够好”给自己贴标签。
basic_info.core_demands: 'These self-doubts affect my motivation and enjoyment in film creation; film creation used to bring me happiness.' Hoping to reduce self-doubt, restore motivation and enjoyment for film creation, and establish a more balanced, realistic self-evaluation.
growth_experiences: 几年前在电影创作上难以盈利，开始持续质疑自己的创造力与能力。每当想到Career development与财务稳定，就感到压力和not安，这一经历成为其Self-doubt的起点，并not断Reinforcement负性自我标签。
过去曾获得多个电影节奖项并收到观众的积极反馈，但来访者倾向忽视这些正向证据，更关注自认为的失败与财务上的not成功，使积极经历not yet能转化为稳定的Self-efficacy。

A recent short film was selected by a famous film festival and screened; at that time they felt proud and excited, briefly acknowledging their own ability and seeing career possibilities; this event provided a positive contrast to their inherent negative narrative.

special_situations.event: 作品not yet能盈利或收入not稳定时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的电影not能赚钱，就说明我not够有才、not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过not断投入更多项目、加倍工作来证明自己有能力
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我从来都挣not到钱，这说明我not够有创意

special_situations.event: 想到Career development和财务稳定的问题时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我without法靠热爱的事情谋生，我就算失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 把注意力全部放在工作与产出上，试图以努力Undoingnot安
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not行，我可能永远without法在这个行业立足

special_situations.event: 与更成功的电影人进行比较时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果达not到他们的成就，我就一without是处
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Persistent self-criticism、用负面标签评价自己
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们，永远达not到他们的水平

special_situations.event: 面对向支持自己的朋友敞开心扉的机会时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果暴露Self-doubt，do not人就会把我看作失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避分享、把情绪压在心里，not向他人求助
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会看not起我，把我当失败者

special_situations.event: 获得奖项或积极反馈时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有财务成功才算真正的成功，其他认可not重要
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate或淡化积极证据，继续以盈利作为唯一标准自我评估
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些not算数，真正的成功是赚钱

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as creative and valuable, hopes to be seen and affirmed in the film industry and to gain a sense of stability
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被视为失败者、害怕not被接纳与贬低，担心without法靠电影谋生而失去自我价值
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being judged by over-investing in work to prove themselves, avoiding exposing vulnerability to friends, and maintaining a controllable evaluation standard through self-labeling

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、容易被negate的创作者
object_relations.object_representation: Others who are more excellent and may judge oneself (successful filmmakers / others)

object_relations.self_representation: 脆弱而担心被看作失败者的人
object_relations.object_representation: Friends who are supportive but may see oneself as a failure (imagined judges)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师探讨其向朋友分享Self-doubt或鼓励其关注与记载积极成就时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to think others will see her as a failure (transference: projecting her own sense of failure onto others' possible views)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a gentle, empathic tone, first validate their worries; then invite them to adduce the facts and counterexamples of 'others seeing them as a failure', distinguish imagination from evidence; encourage balancing the self-evaluation with concrete experiences (awards/screenings), and avoid confrontational wording.

manifestations: 在作品难以盈利后质疑电影创作的意义与自我价值
Equates 'financial success' with 'life/career meaning', ignoring achievements and satisfaction at non-financial levels
outcomes: 生活失衡，忽视自我照顾与社交

manifestations: Living alone且not yet向支持自己的朋友敞开心扉谈及Self-doubt
担心被视为失败者而自我隔离情感
outcomes: 在重要关系中减少真实接触与支持获得

contact_model.definition: 个体克制想对其他人或物做出某个行为的冲动，或放弃了向外寻求do not人为其做某事，转而对自己做；即将原欲对外发出的能量转而对自己。
manifestations: not向支持自己的朋友表达Self-doubt，转而对自己施压
Through doubling investment in projects to 'prove oneself', directing energy toward self-control rather than outside support

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats the external standard of 'must make a living from film to count as success' as the sole criterion for evaluation
Under financial pressure, measures self-worth with profit as the core, ignores awards and audience praise

exception_events.target_problem: 在思考职业与财务稳定或作品not yet盈利时，来访者通常会Self-denial、贴上“have not创造力”的标签，并忽视积极反馈，导致Decreased drive与对创作的享受减少。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 最近短片入选著名电影节并完成展映，当时来访者have not像以往那样negate自己，而是感到自豪与兴奋，并产生“我也许有能力在行业立足”的想法。
exception_events.reason: 线索：获得权威平台的客观认可与外界积极反馈，为其提供了具体、可见的成功证据，使其在该时刻能够暂时摆脱“negate正面”的旧叙事。

positive_force: Has creative ability and external recognition (won film festival awards and audience praise, work selected for a famous film festival)
有少数亲密朋友支持其电影热情
愿意寻求帮助、态度积极并具备自我Reflection能力
negative_force: Self-doubt强烈，常以负性标签定义自我
与他人比较导致自卑与despair
negate积极证据，将盈利作为唯一成功标准
财务压力ReinforcementAnxiety与低自我效能
情感回避与not向朋友表达困扰，削弱社会支持的获得

target_behavior.behavior: 过度投入电影项目以逃避Self-doubt，导致忽视自我照顾与社交
antecedent: 作品not yet盈利或收入not稳定时
与更成功的电影人进行比较后
target_behavior.core_reason: 将盈利与自我价值绑定，在负性情绪中以“加倍工作”来证明能力、控制not安
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的情绪（Self-doubt/羞耻/Anxiety），并尝试获得对能力与价值的外在确认
target_behavior.consequence: Life imbalance and increased physical and mental load instead impair motivation and creativity, further reducing enjoyment of creating

target_behavior.behavior: 以负面标签自我评价（如“我have not创造力”“I am not good enough”）
antecedent: 思考职业与财务稳定时
target_behavior.core_reason: 内化外界成功标准（盈利/地位）并negate正面证据，将暂时性挫折泛化为稳定的自我缺陷
target_behavior.function: 通过自我批评维持一种“可控”的自我解释框架，避免面对not确定性与脆弱感
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-confidence、动力与创造力受损，进一步增加回避与生活失衡
